snippet.title: Storytime! When your teacher has a personal vendetta against you!
snippet.description:
Storytime! When your teacher has a personal vendetta against you!

✨Recipe:
Ingredients:
• 1 box cake mix, plus ingredients called for on the package
• 1 box lemon instant pudding mix, plus ingredients called for on the package
• Fresh raspberries
• Frosting of choice
• Dot sprinkles
• 4 oz canning jars

Directions:
1. Add the raspberries to a blender and blend until smooth. Strain through a fine-mesh strainer to remove the seeds and create a smooth raspberry sauce.
2. Prepare the lemon pudding according to the package directions and set aside.
3. Prepare the cake batter according to the package directions, then spread it evenly onto a large rimmed baking sheet. Spoon small dollops of lemon pudding and raspberry sauce throughout the batter. Using a knife or skewer, gently swirl them into the cake batter without completely mixing them together.
4. Bake according to the cake mix package directions, adjusting the baking time as needed for the thinner layer. Let the cake cool completely.
5. Using a 4 oz canning jar as a cutter, press the opening into the cake to cut out a circle. Carefully press the cake layer into the bottom of the jar with a spoon.
6. Spread a layer of frosting evenly over the cake.
7. Cut out a second cake circle with the jar, then gently press it down on top of the frosting.
8. Add one final layer of frosting, smoothing it until level with the rim of the jar.
9. Press the frosted top into the Dot sprinkles until completely covered.
10. Grab a spoon and dig into this colorful, sprinkle-covered cake-in-a-jar treat!

एका सरकारी रुग्णालयात शंकरकाका आपल्या आजारी पत्नीसाठी औषधं घेण्यासाठी गेले. पण खिशात पुरेसे पैसे नव्हते. त्याच वेळी स्नेहा नावाच्या एका अनोळखी तरुणीने त्यांना मदत केली.

स्नेहाने कोणतीही अपेक्षा न ठेवता केलेली छोटीशी मदत शंकरकाकांसाठी मोठा आधार ठरली.

काही महिन्यांनी स्नेहाची नोकरी गेली. दोन-तीन महिने प्रयत्न करूनही नवीन नोकरी मिळाली नाही. घरभाडं थकलं आणि घरमालकाने खोली खाली करायला सांगितली.

निराश होऊन स्नेहा गावी जाण्यासाठी बसस्टॉपवर उभी होती. त्याच वेळी अचानक शंकरकाकांची तिच्याशी भेट झाली.

पुढे शंकरकाकांनी स्नेहाला दिलेला आधार आणि तिच्या आयुष्यात झालेला बदल मनाला स्पर्श करणारा आहे. ❤️

🙏 या कथेतून एक सुंदर संदेश मिळतो —
माणुसकीने केलेली मदत कधीच वाया जात नाही. योग्य वेळी तीच मदत आपल्यासाठी मोठा आधार बनते.

snippet.description:
На замовлення російських спецслужб убила українського військового. На Рівненщині до суду скерували справу 14-річної дівчини, обвинуваченої у вбивстві 27-річного бійця ЗСУ. За даними слідства, дівчина познайомилася з росіянином у телеграмі й закохалася в куратора, який пообіцяв вивезти її на окуповану територію. Під його контролем вона отруїла українського військового і задушила, коли той знепритомнів. Слідчим також стало відомо, що в листопаді дівчина на замовлення росіян підпалила військовий автомобіль. За це їй обіцяли тисячу доларів, але грошей вона не отримала. Обвинувальні акти скерували до суду. Дівчині загрожує до 15 років ув'язнення.

snippet.description:
Andhra Pradesh’s Anna Canteens are providing affordable meals to poor and needy people for just ₹5. However, claims are circulating on social media alleging that these canteens are serving stale rice and bad-quality food. This video discusses these allegations and questions the authenticity of such claims. According to the account presented in the video, food is prepared fresh in centralized kitchens under hygienic conditions and transported to Anna Canteens in special containers to maintain its temperature and quality. The video alleges that some people are deliberately spreading misleading propaganda to create a negative impression of the scheme and target the Chandrababu Naidu-led coalition government. Anna Canteens were originally introduced during the TDP government to provide affordable meals to the poor. They were closed in August 2019 after YS Jagan Mohan Reddy came to power and were reopened by the coalition government on August 15, 2024, under Chandrababu Naidu’s leadership. While the actual cost of providing a meal is around ₹30, beneficiaries pay only ₹5, with the government bearing the remaining cost. The scheme aims to ensure that no poor person goes hungry because of financial difficulties. The video highlights the importance of verifying information before believing or sharing viral social media content. It also discusses the political debate surrounding Anna Canteens and the allegations of misinformation related to this welfare initiative. Watch the full video to understand the issue, the purpose of Anna Canteens, and the political arguments surrounding this affordable food scheme in Andhra Pradesh.

snippet.title: BỐ TÔI | Hai Anh Em Phần 1174 | Tình Huống Hài Hước Gãy Media
snippet.description:
T16 | TÌNH HUỐNG HỌC ĐƯỜNG – HÀI HƯỚC
Nội dung dành cho khán giả từ 16 tuổi trở lên. Các nhân vật và tình huống được dàn dựng nhằm mục đích giải trí.
------------------------------------
Câu chuyện xoay quanh cuộc sống thường ngày của một nhóm bạn ở làng quê: Hiếu, Thảo, Tuấn, Nhung, Tuyến và Quỳnh. Mỗi người một tính cách, chẳng ai giống ai, nhưng cứ tụ tập với nhau là y như rằng có chuyện. 😆

Hiếu – Học sinh lớp 12, láu cá và thuộc diện “cá biệt”. Hay trốn học đi chơi điện tử nhưng lại rất khéo tay, việc gì cũng biết làm, đặc biệt nấu ăn rất ngon. Nghịch thì nhiều nhưng biết nhận lỗi và rất thương bố.

Thảo – Em gái Hiếu, học lớp 10. Hơi ngây ngô nhưng học giỏi, ngoan và nghe lời bố. Tưởng hiền lành vô hại nhưng lại chính là một trong những “báo thủ” của nhóm.
